notes:
{海老|えび} is the general term for shrimp, prawn, and lobster.

WRITING:
Also written as ⟦{蝦|えび}→蝦：noentry⟧. The kanji {海老|えび} literally means "sea elder" (referring to the curved, aged appearance).

COMMON DISHES:
- ⟦{海老|えび}フライ→海老フライ：noentry⟧: fried shrimp (breaded)
- ⟦{海老天|えびてん}→海老天：noentry⟧: shrimp tempura
- ⟦{海老|えび}チリ→海老チリ：noentry⟧: shrimp in chili sauce
- ⟦{甘海老|あまえび}→甘海老：noentry⟧: sweet shrimp (for sushi)

TYPES:
- ⟦{伊勢海老|いせえび}→伊勢海老：noentry⟧: Japanese spiny lobster
- ⟦{車海老|くるまえび}→車海老：noentry⟧: tiger prawn
- ⟦{桜海老|さくらえび}→桜海老：noentry⟧: sakura shrimp

CULTURAL: Popular as ⟦{おせち料理|おせちりょうり}→おせち料理：26981_osechiryouri⟧ (New Year food) symbolizing longevity.
